question: ¿Cuántos ensayos clínicos de fase 3 (incluye fase 2/3) tienen entre sus intervenciones un fármaco dirigido a EGFR?

attempts.query:
WITH drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT md.parent_chembl_id
  FROM chembl.drug_mechanism dm
  JOIN chembl.target_components tc ON tc.target_chembl_id = dm.target_chembl_id
  JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary md ON md.chembl_id = dm.chembl_id
  WHERE tc.gene_symbol = 'EGFR'
),
names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT lower(p.pref_name) AS n FROM drugs d JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary p ON p.chembl_id = d.parent_chembl_id WHERE p.pref_name IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT lower(s.synonyms) FROM drugs d
  JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary m ON m.parent_chembl_id = d.parent_chembl_id
  JOIN chembl.molecule_synonyms s ON s.chembl_id = m.chembl_id
),
trials AS (
  SELECT nct_id FROM aact.studies WHERE phase IN ('PHASE3','PHASE2/PHASE3')
),
tnames AS (
  SELECT i.nct_id, lower(i.name) AS n FROM aact.interventions i JOIN trials t ON t.nct_id = i.nct_id
  UNION
  SELECT o.nct_id, lower(o.name) FROM aact.intervention_other_names o JOIN trials t ON t.nct_id = o.nct_id
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT tn.nct_id)
FROM names nm JOIN tnames tn ON tn.n ~ ('\m' || regexp_replace(nm.n, '([.*+?^${}()|\[\]\\])', '\\\1', 'g') || '\M')
